Nice washable tent for indoor reading and play or a pleasant day outside. Relatively easy to setup, posts with holes go on the top to thread through with ties to help keep it stable. Note on wooden or bare floors the front two posts will slide out to the sides and prevent the front flaps from being able to close fully. Solution seems to be putting the bottoms of the front two posts on the provided mat and then they won't slide out. The back posts can then be spread out so the tent is taunt. Would not be an issue on carpet or grass.
